title: AI Unlocked: Entrepreneurship & Growth
blurb: Beyond the launch: AI-native market research, operations automation, fundraising and pitch materials, growth engines, and an AI-leveraged operating model for founders scaling past themselves. (Launching from zero? Start with AI Unlocked: Entrepreneurship.)

modules.body:
The shift

AI collapses the cost of research, content, admin, and first-draft everything. Founders who internalize this run leaner, test faster, and reserve human hires for judgment and relationships. This course assumes you have a business (or a validated idea from our Entrepreneurship class) and want scale.

  • Map your business on one page (BMC refresher) and mark every block AI can accelerate.
  • Identify your three highest-cost repeated tasks — they become your automation targets.
Kai-Fu Lee’s thesis in AI Superpowers: implementation beats invention — the founders who win are those who deploy AI against unglamorous, valuable problems faster than incumbents can react. This course is a four-week implementation sprint on your own company.

modules.d: Deep research workflows that replace a junior analyst.
modules.body:
Workflows

  • Market maps: "Act as a market analyst; map the [niche] market: segments, sizes, buyer triggers, top 5 competitors with pricing and weaknesses, and 3 exploitable gaps."
  • Voice-of-customer mining: paste reviews/support logs → themes, verbatims, unmet needs.
  • Pricing studies: competitor scrape summaries → 3-tier pricing proposal with rationale.
  • Tools: Perplexity/Claude for research synthesis; spreadsheet AI (Copilot/Gemini) for models; NotebookLM to interrogate industry reports.
plAIbox™: deliver a 5-page intelligence brief on your own market and present the 3 gaps you'll attack this quarter.
🧪 Interactive Lab — try it now

Act as a senior market analyst. Map the [niche] market for me: segments and sizes, buyer triggers, top 5 competitors with pricing and weaknesses, and the 3 most exploitable gaps for a company with my resources: [describe]. Format as a brief I could hand to an investor.

modules.d: Tool study: Make vs Zapier vs native AI features — your back office on autopilot.
modules.body:
Comparative snapshot

  • Zapier: easiest, 6000+ integrations — first automations in an afternoon.
  • Make: stronger free plan, visual multi-step scenarios — best value at volume.
  • Native AI (HubSpot AI, QuickBooks assist, Notion AI): automation inside tools you already pay for.
  • Priority builds: lead intake → CRM + instant reply; invoice chase sequences; content calendar → scheduled posts; weekly KPI digest to your phone.
Rule: human approval wherever money moves or a customer is addressed.

modules.d: Decks, models, and investor Q&A rehearsal.
modules.body:
Workflows

  • Narrative: problem → insight → traction → ask, drafted with role-stacked AI (VC analyst + storyteller) and stress-tested with devil's advocate.
  • Deck: structure in Claude, design in Gamma/Canva against your brand kit.
  • Model sanity: AI-checked assumptions, unit economics, and a defensible use-of-funds table.
  • Rehearsal: voice-mode investor grilling — "Ask me the 10 hardest questions about this deck; score my answers."
plAIbox™: deliver a 10-slide deck plus a recorded 3-minute pitch, panel-reviewed by mentors.

modules.d: Content flywheels, referral systems, and AI-personalized retention.
modules.body:
Build the flywheel

  • One pillar content piece weekly → AI-recycled into 10 platform-native assets.
  • Referral program drafted, incentivized, and automated (from our Entrepreneurship playbook, scaled).
  • Retention: AI-segmented customer lists, win-back sequences, and churn-signal monitoring in your control sheet.
  • KPI discipline: SOSTAC Control at growth stage — weekly dashboard prompt reviewing revenue, CAC proxies, top/bottom actions.

modules.d: The founder’s system, documented and running.
modules.body:
Capstone

  • Your automation stack live (≥3 automations), intelligence brief, growth flywheel calendar, and pitch pack.
  • A one-page AI Operating Model: tools, owners, approval points, and weekly cadence.
  • Present traction deltas after two weeks of operation.
